# Weieryang

Website: https://weieryang.com
Company: Weieryang (Wuhan) Information Technology Co., Ltd.
Contact: tangkelian@weieryang.com; +86 13317178019

Weieryang supplies compressed sofas, sofa beds and modular sofa solutions for B2B furniture buyers, including importers, wholesalers, distributors, online furniture brands and private label projects.

Core product categories:
- Compressed sofas and vacuum packed sofas
- Sofa beds
- Modular and sectional sofas
- OEM / ODM sofa projects
- Sofa fabric and color customization
- Carton packing and compressed sofa container loading support

Quotation requirements:
Buyers should provide model number, order quantity, destination country, preferred fabric/color, packing requirement and target price.
